newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Mello stock suspended in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Banco Mello stock suspended in Lisbon.

text.p: Share trade in Banco Mello Comercial has been suspended on the orders of the Portugal's Financial Markets Committee (CMVM), dealers said.
Dealers said the suspension could be due to a press report.

Lisbon daily Diario Economico said today that industrialists Ilidio Pinho and Nelson Quintas each acquired a stake of 7.6 percent in Uniao de Bancos Portugueses (UBP) to help the Jose de Mello group acquire the bank, which has been renamed Banco Mello Comercial.
